svg.text: B200 · TriangleAttention (starting node) · training · D128, 4 heads × 32, bf16, broadcast dropout, every L = 128k
forward (saves x, q, k, v, g, b, o, lse, w_4, w_o, prm, ds)
q, k, v, g = (x_n @ W.T for W in w_4)
F3 · gate + out proj + dropout + residual
mask, ds, W_*, w_4, w_o, prm
do, dg = du * s_g, du * o * s_g * (1 - s_g)
Δ = (do * o).sum per head; dW_o[cta] = (ds*dy).T @ (s_g*o) # this CTA's rows
dp = do @ v.T; ds_ = p * (dp - Δ)
dv = p.T @ do; dk = ds_.T @ q / sqrt(32)
dx_n = cat(dq, dk, dv, dg) @ w_4 + db @ W_b
M[t][cta] = xhat.T @ d[t] (t = q, k, v, g; this CTA's rows)
M[t], dW_o = sum over CTAs, in CTA order # same bits every run
dW[t] = γ * M[t] + outer(β, d[t].sum(0)); dγ, dβ, dW_b
M / vector partials (fp32, one per CTA)
x, q, k, v, g, o (saved)
